items.title: Startup Helper Compatibility — make the upgraded protocol executable in this public repo
items.summary: The current worktree imported Studio OS helper modules that do not exist locally, which breaks `compact-handoff`, `render-startup-brief`, and direct blocker preflight execution. A public game repo can consume richer Studio protocol features only if missing helper paths degrade locally instead of aborting session start.
items.recipe: Add repo-local compatibility modules for `turn-classifier`, `visual-blocks`, `sil-forecaster`, and `blocker-rules`; keep the helpers deterministic, dependency-free, and safe for public-repo execution.

items.title: Codex Plan-Mode Exemption — stop asking Codex to run Claude Code slash commands
items.summary: `verify-plan-mode` regressed the prior Codex exemption and now reports `MISSING` for a Claude-only `/model opusplan` runtime feature. That creates a false protocol blocker in Codex sessions and contradicts the existing project decision from Session 61.
items.recipe: Restore session-lock agent detection, stamp Codex/non-Claude sessions as `not_required`, and validate the JSON output from a Codex session lock.

items.title: SIL Invariant Repair — make the status score equal the category truth
items.summary: The new write helper correctly caught `silScore=1000` while the ten SIL categories sum to `999` because Automation Coverage is `99`. Leaving the mismatch would make the startup score box a plausible-looking lie, exactly what CANON-031 forbids.
items.recipe: Run `scripts/lib/write-project-status.mjs --fix`, keep the category values unchanged, and validate `--check` after the write.

items.title: Protocol Script Smoke — prove the repaired start/closeout path runs
items.summary: This repo is deployed and public-unlaunched; session automation failures now cost more than another feature polish slice because they erode launch confidence and closeout reliability. The correct bar is not syntax validity, but actual runtime proof for the scripts `/start` and `/closeout` depend on.
items.recipe: Run `compact-handoff`, `render-startup-brief`, `validate-brief-format`, `blocker-preflight`, `context-meter`, and targeted test/lint checks after the helper repair.
